<div class="card-body">
'''Gold 1''' is a [[Light]] [[Starship]] from [[Premiere (Japanese)|Premiere (Japanese)]].
<nowiki />
<h2>Title</h2>
<span lang="ja">ゴールド１</span>
<h2>Card Text</h2>
<span lang="ja">パイロットか乗客を２名まで乗せられる。パイロットがいなければ、戦闘力、回避値、航行速度は使えない。</span><ref name="jp-face">[[:File:Japanese-Premiere-1301-141o-Face.jpg|Original Japanese printed face]].</ref>
<h2>Lore</h2>
''<span lang="ja">ヤヴィンの戦いのゴールド中隊の隊長機。パイロットは、ジョン・“ダッチ”・ヴァンダー。同機はレンフォーラ基地ではスペクター１であった。</span>''<ref name="jp-face" />
<h2>Translation of Japanese Text</h2>
'''Title:''' Gold 1.

'''Card text:''' May carry up to two pilots or passengers. Without a pilot, its power, maneuver, and hyperspeed cannot be used.

'''Lore:''' Gold Squadron's lead ship at the Battle of Yavin. Its pilot was Jon “Dutch” Vander. At Renforra Base the same ship was Specter 1.
<h2>Notes</h2>
Japanese-language printing of [[Gold 1]] in [[Premiere (Japanese)]].<ref name="encyc">[https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf SWCCG Collecting Encyclopedia 3.2], pp. 41, 97. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261008192828/https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf Internet Archive].</ref><ref name="jp-face" />
